facts.fact: Gabon inaugurated its first sovereign data center at Nkok on 3 July 2026, run by ST Digital to host data of the state, banks, firms and telecom operators; 92 racks, CFA 8 billion.
The Nkok data center inaugurated 3 July 2026 is stated to be Tier III-certified; certifying body not named.

note: Also says per African Energy Chamber Gabon had no data centre as of mid-2025 before Nkok opened; not recorded as none since superseded by the opening.
